description: Create two Airflow DAGs for health_portal: 'claims_raw_load' (parent) and 'claims_quality_metrics' (child), wired so that clearing the parent's final task also clears the dependent child task. The parent must end with an ExternalTaskMarker pointing at the child's ExternalTaskSensor. The child must: (1) wait on the parent's final load task, (2) compute quality metrics for the day partition with delete-then-insert semantics, (3) publish metrics. Both run daily, parent at 02:00 UTC and child at 02:30 UTC.
edge_cases: The marker's execution_date must be offset by +30 minutes to match the child's logical date; the default (same logical date) points at a nonexistent run
The child sensor's execution_delta (30 minutes) is the mirror of the marker offset
Metrics task must be idempotent because it will be re-executed after a parent clear
ExternalTaskMarker only propagates when the parent is cleared with the 'Recursive' option
common_failure_modes: FM6: Marker without an execution_date offset silently clears nothing in the child DAG
FM6: Child sensor waits on the marker task itself instead of the load task, creating a circular wait
FM3: Metrics appended on re-run, doubling counts for the reprocessed day
